For individuals and families

How we can help

All services

Family Law

Clear, practical advice on separation, finances and children.

  • Divorce, separation and dissolution of civil partnerships
  • Financial remedy proceedings, consent orders, maintenance and pension sharing
  • Pre-nuptial and post-nuptial agreements
  • Child arrangements, specific issue and prohibited steps orders
  • Non-molestation and occupation orders, and urgent applications
Family Law

Immigration

UK immigration advice, from first application to appeal.

  • Skilled Worker, Global Talent and Global Business Mobility visas
  • Sponsor licences and compliance
  • Spouse, partner, parent and child applications
  • Indefinite leave to remain and British citizenship
  • Administrative review, First-tier Tribunal appeals and judicial review
Immigration

Criminal Defence

From the first police or council contact through to trial. Early advice matters.

  • Police station and voluntary interviews, bail and pre-charge representations
  • Interviews under caution by council investigators
  • Magistrates’ Court trials and sentencing
  • Crown Court matters with counsel, and appeals
  • Local authority offences
Criminal Defence

Licensing and Regulatory

We act for applicants and for licensing authorities, so we understand both sides of a hearing.

  • Premises licences, variations, temporary event notices and reviews
  • Taxi and private hire: driver, vehicle and operator licences
  • Suspensions, revocations and appeals
  • Licensing hearings
  • Advice for licensing authorities
Licensing and Regulatory

Property and Housing

Advice for landlords, tenants and local authorities.

  • First-tier Tribunal appeals: improvement notices and civil financial penalties
  • Selective and HMO licensing, and rent repayment orders
  • Possession claims, disrepair and unlawful eviction
  • Landlord and tenant matters
  • Renters’ Rights Act compliance
Property and Housing

Technology, Data and AI Governance

Senior data protection, privacy and AI governance support for UK businesses, without the full-time hire.

Fractional DPO

Data protection and privacy

Cyber and technology contracts

  1. 01
